description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmploymentContractAPITest' for testing the 'EmploymentContractAPI' of the OrangeHRM PIM module. It includes setup, various test methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and attachment handling related to employment contracts.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of the EmploymentContractAPI endpoints including CRUD operations, validation rules, and attachment management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating specific database tables before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Tests that the API returns an instance of EmploymentContractService.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employment contract by employee number, including cases with existing and non-existing contracts.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for fetching a single contract.

methods.name: testUpdateOnlyDates
methods.description: Tests updating only the start and end dates of an employment contract.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests adding a new contract attachment to an employment contract.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachmentBadRequest
methods.description: Ensures bad request is handled when updating with invalid contract attachment data.

methods.name: testUpdateDeleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests deleting a contract attachment from an employment contract.

methods.name: testUpdateReplaceContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests replacing an existing contract attachment with a new one.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the update operation's validation rules.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed current date for testing purposes.
